data.title: Trump posts AI-generated video of Iran’s Kharg Island ‘blown to smithereens’ hours after first US strikes in a month
data.description: Donald Trump posted an AI video showing Iran’s Kharg Island destroyed, hours after real US airstrikes hit rocket launchers on Larak Island.
